## `decisions` (`data/decisions.parquet`, config `default`)

One row per entry on one of CBCA's eight decision listing pages (https://www.cbca.gov/decisions/), after removing exact repeats on the same page. A PDF listed on two pages is a row on each.

Non-null and non-blank are shares of the table's rows; non-blank also leaves out empty strings.

| column | type | description | non-null | non-blank | example |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `id` | string | Stable key: the first 12 hex characters of the SHA-1 of listing page URL, decision URL, case number and decision date joined with `\|`. Primary key. | 100.0% | 100.0% | `a91506e7f3cf` |
| `board` | string | Always `CBCA`. | 100.0% | 100.0% | `CBCA` |
| `case_type` | string | Which listing page the row is on, as a label: `Contract Disputes Act`, `Relocation`, `Travel`, `ISDA (Indian Self-Determination Act)`, `FEMA arbitration`, `FCIC (crop insurance)`, `Debt` or `Rate`. | 100.0% | 100.0% | `FEMA arbitration` |
| `case_number` | string | The case number cell as listed, whitespace collapsed (e.g. `CBCA 8250, 8251`). | 100.0% | 100.0% | `CBCA 9028-FEMA` |
| `dockets` | string | `case_number` split into one docket per case number, `; `-separated (e.g. `CBCA 8250; CBCA 8251`). Suffixes such as `-RELO` are kept. A number with no board prefix gets `CBCA`; another prefix as listed (GSBCA, or the listing's one `CCBCA`) is kept. | 100.0% | 100.0% | `CBCA 9028-FEMA` |
| `docket_count` | int64 | Number of dockets in `dockets`. | 100.0% | 100.0% | `1` |
| `party` | string | The party cell as listed (the appellant, claimant, applicant or petitioner); this is the cell linked to the decision. | 100.0% | 100.0% | `County of Sacramento, California` |
| `party_role` | string | The listing table's heading for the party column: `Appellant`, `Claimant`, `Applicant` or `Petitioner`. | 100.0% | 100.0% | `Applicant` |
| `judge` | string | The judge cell as listed, misspellings included. | 100.0% | 100.0% | `Sullivan` |
| `decision_type` | string | Contract Disputes Act page only, since 2015: the type cell (`Decision`, `Dismissal`, `Order`, `Full Board Order`), with the misspellings `Decison` and `Decsion` corrected to `Decision`. Null on the other pages and earlier years. | 33.7% | 33.7% | `Decision` |
| `decision_type_raw` | string | The type cell exactly as listed, before the spelling fix. | 33.7% | 33.7% | `Decision` |
| `decision_date` | date32[day] | The date cell, parsed (MM/DD/YYYY, MM/DD/YY or MM-DD-YYYY on the listing). | 100.0% | 100.0% | `2026-10-27` |
| `agency` | string | Not on the listing. Read from the decision text: the Respondent in the caption, or else the first `appearing for ...` or `counsel for ...` naming a federal body. Upper-cased, otherwise as written (typos in the decision stay). Null when neither is found. | 98.8% | 98.8% | `FEDERAL EMERGENCY MANAGEMENT AGENCY` |
| `agency_source` | string | Where `agency` came from: `caption: Respondent` or `appearing for / counsel for`. Null when `agency` is null. | 98.8% | 98.8% | `appearing for / counsel for` |
| `decision_url` | string | Link to the decision from the listing row, made absolute and percent-encoded. Kept as listed even when it is broken (see `text_status`). | 100.0% | 100.0% | `https://www.cbca.gov/files/decisions/2026/SULLIVAN_10-27-26_...` |
| `file_format` | string | What the link returned: `pdf` or `html` (a few early decisions are HTML pages). Null when it wasn't fetched or didn't return a document. | 100.0% | 100.0% | `pdf` |
| `listing_page` | string | URL of the listing page the row is on. | 100.0% | 100.0% | `https://www.cbca.gov/decisions/fema.html` |
| `also_listed_on` | string | Other listing page(s) linking the same `decision_url`, `; `-separated. Null for most rows. | 0.1% | 0.1% | `https://www.cbca.gov/decisions/travel.html` |
| `pdf_pages` | int64 | Number of pages in the PDF, from pypdf. Null when there is no PDF (no link, a failed download, or an HTML decision). | 99.9% | 99.9% | `7` |
| `text_chars` | int64 | Length of the extracted text in characters (0 when a PDF gave no text). Null when no document was downloaded. | 100.0% | 100.0% | `14263` |
| `text_status` | string | Result of fetching and extracting the decision: `ok`; `little or no text (likely scanned)` (under 200 characters from a PDF); `partial (a page has no text, likely scanned)`; `partial (some pages failed)`; `extract failed`; `HTTP <code>`; `not a PDF or HTML`; `not fetched`; or `no link on listing`. | 100.0% | 100.0% | `ok` |
| `date_in_text` | bool | True if `decision_date`, written as `Month D, YYYY`, appears in the first 3,000 characters of the text. Null when there is no text. | 99.7% | 99.7% | `True` |
| `docket_in_text` | bool | True if one of the bare docket numbers from `dockets` appears anywhere in the text (not as part of a longer number). Null when there is no text. | 99.7% | 99.7% | `True` |
| `docket_in_file_name` | bool | True if one of the bare docket numbers appears in the file name at the end of `decision_url`. Null when there is no link. | 100.0% | 100.0% | `True` |
| `text` | string | The decision text extracted from the PDF with pypdf (no OCR), or the page text for HTML decisions. Null when nothing was extracted. | 99.7% | 99.7% | `October 27, 2026 CBCA 9028-FEMA In the Matter of COUNTY OF S...` |
| `fetched_at` | string | When the decision link was requested, UTC, ISO 8601 (also set when the request failed). Null when there is no link. | 100.0% | 100.0% | `2026-11-15T12:59:00+00:00` |
